cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:702.title: Store Floor Lead (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:702.team: 133 - SouthGlenn - Sur La Table, 6853 South York Street, Suite 115, Centennial, CO 80122
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:702.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Store Floor Lead serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. · Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Support the achievement of store sales goals through effective customer engagement and team motivation. · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance · Direct employees to ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels and that the selling floor is adequately stocked and merchandised in accordance with visual standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Workweeks are expected to be between 20 and 25 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience · Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4dbeb988-5726-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in France. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Generate actionable insights that help improve product performance, customer engagement, retention, and business outcomes. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence collaborating across Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and senior leadership. Our partner is looking for a Founding AI Forward Deployed Engineer based in United States. This is a founding engineering role focused on deploying production-grade agentic AI solutions directly within enterprise customer environments. You will own strategic deployments end to end, from discovery and workflow analysis through production launch, optimization, ROI validation, and expansion. The role combines hands-on software engineering with customer-facing technical leadership across voice and digital AI experiences. You will build multi-turn agents, integrations, retrieval pipelines, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability capabilities for real-world use cases. Your work will directly influence product strategy, engineering priorities, deployment methodologies, and the future structure of the forward-deployed engineering function. You will also contribute to pre-sales through technical demonstrations, architectural discussions, proof-of-concepts, and deployment scoping. Proven experience independently building, integrating, debugging, and supporting production APIs and customer-facing systems. Hands-on experience working with LLMs in production environments, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, evaluation, prompt architecture, and tool use. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a11bc8dd-95f7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Investor Relations Associate based in Canada. This is a remote, relationship-driven role focused on building trust with family offices and high-net-worth investors. You will support live fundraising mandates while developing and expanding your own network of allocators. The role combines investor qualification, relationship management, research, briefing preparation, and thoughtful follow-up. You will work closely with a senior investor team and gain hands-on exposure to live deal flow from the start. Success depends on your ability to identify relevant investors, earn meaningful conversations, and build lasting relationships. You will operate in a fast-moving, senior, and highly autonomous environment where discretion and sound judgment are essential. The position also offers an opportunity to grow into ownership of your own investor network and progressively take on greater responsibility. Build and manage a growing portfolio of allocator relationships, including family offices and high-net-worth individuals, while keeping existing relationships engaged between opportunities. Support live fundraising mandates by qualifying investors, preparing concise and high-quality briefing notes, coordinating follow-ups, and ensuring strong execution throughout the process. Develop a consistent pipeline of new investor relationships by identifying relevant allocators and creating a regular cadence of first conversations. Research investors to understand their investment strategies, interests, and potential appetite for direct investments, particularly in US startups. Develop and maintain trusted relationships by providing relevant, thoughtful communication rather than relying on transactional or overly promotional outreach. Work alongside senior investor professionals to observe investor conversations, contribute to mandate execution, and progressively develop independent judgment. Use AI-powered tools and modern workflow technologies to streamline research, preparation, and pipeline management, allowing greater focus on relationship building. Handle sensitive investor information with a high degree of discretion, ensuring names, allocations, conversations, and other confidential details remain protected. Requirements Demonstrated experience beginning to build an allocator or investor network through wealth management, private banking, family office, placement, investor relations, or another relevant environment. Evidence of independently establishing relationships and opening new investor conversations rather than relying solely on an existing institutional network. A clear and repeatable approach to identifying relevant investors, initiating conversations, establishing credibility, and maintaining relationships over time. Strong understanding of how investors allocate capital, ideally including familiarity with direct investments in US startups. Excellent listening and relationship-building skills, with a consultative approach that prioritizes investor needs and respects their time. High level of discretion, integrity, and professionalism when handling confidential investor information and sensitive conversations. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple relationships, mandates, follow-ups, and priorities with consistency. Comfort working autonomously in a remote, asynchronous environment while collaborating effectively with a senior team. Willingness and ability to use AI tools for investor research, preparation, and pipeline management as part of a modern, technology-enabled workflow. Benefits Fully remote position with an asynchronous working environment. Workday overlap with US Eastern Time for several hours rather than requiring full US working hours. southparkcommons-meesho:lever:b7f20190-5.description: About the Team: The BizFin team at Meesho is a close-knit and high-performing group that brings together a diverse mix of professionals from Big 4 consulting, FMCG giants, and top-tier investment firms. Our members include Chartered Accountants (many of whom are rank holders), business specialists, and former investment bankers — each contributing a unique perspective and skill set. We thrive on solving complex, high-impact business problems across Meesho’s ecosystem. Whether it's driving growth strategy or streamlining financial operations, the team plays a critical role in shaping key decisions that drive the company's success. We believe in cross-functional exposure, ensuring team members gain experience across different areas of the business, enabling continuous learning and a broader perspective. At our core, we value both excellence in our work and strong team bonds, creating a culture that celebrates collaboration, achievement, and the collective impact we make. About the Role: As Associate Director - Business Finance, you’ll strategise with the business team and tell us how and where to spend our money. While you ensure governance and controllership are best in class, more importantly you actively work with CXOs to drive prioritisation/ choices around growth and profitability. You will lead a team of expert finance professionals - who will aid you in problem discovery, implementing complex business solutions, playing the critical challenger role in business orgs and being co-pilot in leadership level decision-making. You’ll also manage business development activities according to a financial plan. You’ll modify financial plans and budget amounts based on the changes in business plans. You’ll also provide financial support and advice to management in closing business deals and short/medium/long term strategies.

southparkcommons-simular:ashbyhq:e11f7c0.description: Where multiple locations are listed for this role, the position may be based in any of those locations, with priority determined according to the order of listing. We're looking for someone to own the relationship between our product and our users, keeping them unblocked, turning their feedback into product insights, and building systems that make every interaction count. What you'll do - Serve as the primary point of contact for user questions, feedback, and escalations. - Triage incoming user issues, troubleshoot, and partner with engineering and product to drive resolution. - Build and maintain support workflows, knowledge bases, and self-serve resources. - Aggregate and synthesize user feedback into product insights that influence the roadmap. - Identify opportunities to automate operational work using AI agents and internal tooling. - Track key user-experience metrics (response time, resolution rate, satisfaction) and continuously raise the bar. What we're looking for - 2-4 years in product operations, user operations, customer success, or a similar role. - Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field. - Experience setting up or managing customer support systems and ticketing platforms (e.g. Intercom, Zendesk, or similar). - Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to track metrics, identify trends, and turn user data into actionable insights. - Strong bias towards automation and building systems, not just resolving individual tickets. - Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex issues clearly. - Genuine interest in AI products and how they work. Bonus - Experience with AI agents or workflow automation tools.
